source: owner handoff 2026-10-01 (approved final): Super FUMBBL Team Icons/action-icons/match-results/HANDOFF-WIN-LOSS-DRAW.md + handoff-manifest.json
note: Approved label masters trimmed to content (alpha > 40) and Lanczos-resampled (premultiplied) to 1x/2x/3x of the CSS size, so the LETTERS of all three labels share one height (40 CSS px). textCenterX = the centre of the lettering in CSS px from the image left edge; the client centres THAT on the result box and lets the symbol sit to its left. Original artwork (built-in image generation, owner-approved); no third-party or GW-derived imagery.

assets.name: win-label-v2
assets.prompt: Create one horizontal WIN result icon for a brutal fantasy football game called Super FUMBBL. Fresh variation with much more fantasy football personality than a generic trophy. LEFT: a squat battered gold trophy holding an unmistakable brown oval American football with ivory laces and TWO steel hoops near the ball ends; short triangular spikes attach ONLY to these metal hoops. Trophy has sturdy angular handles and riveted base. RIGHT: bold uppercase WIN in chunky gold arcade block lettering, ivory highlights, amber shadows, thick black outline. Retro 16-bit pixel art with deliberate large pixel clusters, limited rich palette, bold contours. Sports equipment, heavy metal rivets, modest chips and dents, rugged rather than elegant. Compact readable UI graphic, one dominant symbol, no tiny clutter. Football trophy and text balanced, text height about 70 percent icon height. Centered horizontal layout, transparent gap between symbol and word, safe margins. Genuine transparent alpha background. No scene, border panel, official logos or additional words.

assets.name: loss-label-v2
assets.prompt: Create one horizontal LOSS result icon, matching reference WIN graphic's rugged retro fantasy football pixel-art style and typography. LEFT: an empty battered dark red American football helmet in three-quarter side view, unmistakable bent steel face cage, one large crushed dent on crown, a broken short metal spike on its side and chunky rivets. No person inside, no head, no gore. Strong helmet silhouette, simple large damage shapes, readable at small size. RIGHT: exact uppercase LOSS in large red block/slab arcade letters with pale highlights, deep crimson shadows, black outline, a few broad chips, matching reference lettering weight. Symbol and word separated by transparent space. Rugged fantasy sports equipment, chunky pixel art, limited palette, clear contours, upper-left highlights. Text cap height approximately 70 percent helmet height. Compact horizontal UI asset with safe margins. Genuine transparent alpha background, no panel, scene, other words or logos.

assets.name: draw-label-v2
assets.prompt: Create one horizontal DRAW result icon matching supplied WIN graphic's rugged retro fantasy football pixel-art style and lettering. LEFT: two chunky armored football gauntlets pressing knuckle-to-knuckle horizontally, equally matched in a stalemate, one ivory/gold from left and one dark steel/blue from right. Both closed fists in simple side profile; no spread fingers or interlaced hands. Thick riveted wrist cuffs, short armor spikes only on cuffs, bold readable shape. Small bright silver equals sign above the fist contact to clarify tied result. No explosion or winner. RIGHT: exact uppercase DRAW in large silver-white arcade slab/block letters, cool steel-blue bevel shadows, black outline, few broad scuffs. Same typography weight and lighting as reference. Retro 16-bit chunky pixel clusters, high contrast, minimal detail for small UI display. Separate symbol and word with transparent gap, text about 70 percent symbol height. Compact horizontal asset, genuine transparent alpha, full safe margins. No scene, panel, other words or logos.
